PURPOSE: Append-oriented locator seed for authority-referenced canonical finding definitions outside NEXY-BUILD-CONTROL/FINDINGS/**. Each locator must be revalidated against the pinned control snapshot used to generate a manifest.
VALIDATION_RULES: FINDING_ID values must be unique in this locator manifest.
At manifest-generation snapshot, each DEFINITION_PATH must exist.
The definition parsed at DEFINITION_PATH must declare FINDING_ID exactly equal to the locator FINDING_ID.
If the same FINDING_ID is defined under the primary findings root, duplicate-path identity rules in the contract apply; locator presence must not override the primary definition silently.
A locator does not imply that the finding is open, blocking, control-plane relevant, or terminal; downstream projection decides those semantics from authoritative evidence.
